desc: The MDT LSS GEN3-the most adaptable and customizable rifle chassis ever built. Whether you're building a competition-ready precision rifle, dialing in a lightweight hunting setup, or putting together a tactical beast, this system lets you customize every detail without ever pulling your barreled action. Swap parts, tweak your setup, and make it exactly what you need, when you need it. The LSS GEN3 Chassis starts a base-a platform-a blank canvas. Swap buttstocks, grips, and forends to build your rifle exactly how you want it. Whether you're shooting PRS, hunting deep in the backcountry, or need a compact truck gun, the LSS GEN3 can be adapted to fit any scenario. Swap parts at will and change your rifles' purpose. With interchangeable components, the LSS GEN3 supports over a million possible build combinations-ensuring your rifle is uniquely yours. If you can dream it, you can build it. The LSS GEN3 chassis allows you to select the perfect forend for your build-or run it without one. Whether you're after the ultimate compact build, PRS-style competition performance, or tactical adaptability, MDT has got you covered.
